news.title: DeepSeek目标在新一轮融资中实现$10B估值
news.snippet: AI创新者DeepSeek正寻求至少$300M融资，目标估值达100亿美元。
news.raw_snippet: AI innovator DeepSeek is in talks to raise at least $300 million at a $10 billion valuation, underscoring its significant market potential. Chinese AI innovator **DeepSeek** is reportedly in advanced discussions to secure a substantial funding injection, aiming for a commanding **$10 billion valuation**. The reported valuation suggests that DeepSeek is positioning itself among the top-tier AI players, reflecting its perceived technological prowess and market potential. Startups that can deliver efficient, powerful, and cost-effective AI solutions are attracting significant investor attention, as evidenced by the valuation DeepSeek is reportedly targeting. DeepSeek's previous contributions, including the introduction of cost-effective AI models that garnered considerable industry attention, have laid the groundwork for this ambitious funding objective. The company's ability to disrupt the market with innovative, accessible technology has clearly resonated with investors looking for the next wave of AI leaders. The successful closure of this round would not only bolster DeepSeek's financial standing but also solidify its competitive position against both domestic and international AI rivals.

news.title: Physical Intelligence获超$1 Billion融资，投资者押注AI机器人
news.snippet: Physical Intelligence完成超10亿美元融资，投资者大举押注AI驱动机器人技术。
news.raw_snippet: # Physical Intelligence Secures Over $1 Billion in Funding as Investors Bet Big on AI-Powered Robotics. Physical Intelligence, a San Francisco-based robotics and artificial intelligence startup, has rapidly emerged as one of the most well-funded ventures in the burgeoning field of AI-driven robotics, securing more than **$1 billion** in financing since its founding in 2024 and achieving a multibillion-dollar valuation. The company’s latest major investment came in **November 2025**, when it raised **$600 million** in a **Series B funding round** that propelled its post-money valuation to about **$5.6 billion**. Before this significant Series B, Physical Intelligence had already made waves in the robotics and AI communities with its **$400 million Series A round in November 2024**, which valued the company around **$2.4 billion**. The startup’s funding trajectory has been extraordinarily fast: after a **$70 million seed round in March 2024** that helped establish operations and initial research, Physical Intelligence’s valuation jumped several fold with each subsequent financing, a pace rarely seen even in the fast-moving AI sector.

news.title: Cursor以$50 Billion估值融资$2 Billion，AI编程工具受追捧
news.snippet: AI编程工具Cursor正以500亿美元估值筹集20亿美元资金。
news.raw_snippet: # Cursor is raising $2 billion at a $50 billion valuation as AI coding tools become the fastest-growing software category. Cursor is raising $2 billion at a $50 billion valuation as AI coding tools become the fastest-growing software category. *In short: AI coding startup Cursor (Anysphere) is in talks to raise at least $2 billion at a $50 billion valuation, co-led by Andreessen Horowitz, Thrive Capital, and Nvidia, nearly doubling its November 2025 valuation of $29.3 billion. The company has grown from zero to $2 billion ARR in three years – the fastest B2B scaling on record – with 1 million+ paying customers and 70% of the Fortune 1,000 in its customer base, though it faces intensifying competition from GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Windsurf.*. Cursor, the AI code editor built by Anysphere, is in talks to raise at least $2 billion in new funding at a valuation of roughly $50 billion.

news.title: AI独角兽DeepSeek寻求首轮融资，估值或超680亿元人民币
news.snippet: 中国AI公司DeepSeek reportedly寻求首轮融资，估值可能超过680亿元人民币。
news.raw_snippet: Chinese artificial intelligence company DeepSeek is reportedly initiating its first external fundraising since its founding, targeting a valuation exceeding $10.0 billion (approximately CNY 68 billion) and planning to raise at least $3 billion. The fundraising is driven by multiple pressures: the high costs of AI large model development, fierce talent competition, and accelerated industry iteration. The funds will primarily support the R&D and deployment of its next-generation flagship model, V4, which has focused significant investment on adapting to domestic Chinese chips. DeepSeek, a star startup in China's artificial intelligence field, is reportedly initiating its first external fundraising since its founding, targeting a valuation exceeding $10.0 billion (approximately CNY 68 billion). A person from a large state-owned equity institution told media that the news of DeepSeek initiating its first external fundraising is "very likely true," adding that "it's completely impossible to get in on the investment right now." Another venture capital analyst noted that for a top-tier project like DeepSeek, investment shares "generally have to be fought over.".

news.snippet: 创业者利用AI Agent构建精简三人团队实现即时盈利，应对AI时代就业变革。
news.raw_snippet: “I got laid off nine months ago, and it was AI-related,” said Brown, 48, with a career that stretches back to 2000, aside from a few months as a ball boy for the Denver Nuggets in his youth. “We launched 2.5 months ago, and right now, we have $300,000 in ARR,” said Brown, who manages the three-person company’s finances as the president of Fathom AI. “The VC said, ‘You’re going to need an engineering team of this size, a customer success team of this size,'” Brown recalled, adding that when he and Fathom’s founder and CEO Ben Hooten walked out of the meeting, they basically said, “We’re not going to need that.”. The company, he said, couldn’t afford the subscription, but every one of those six reps paid individually to work with Fathom AI. In this industry, he added, sometimes tech sales is “just uninspiring.” With Fathom, he said he feels like they’re making “something that makes a difference.”.

news.title: 人工智能vs自然愚蠢：为何Gen AI与LLM不会终结人类
news.snippet: LeCun指出LLM只是通往真正AI的"岔路"，Gen AI和LLM不会导致人类终结。
news.raw_snippet: LeCun’s exact framing: LLMs are “an off-ramp on the road to human-level AI.” Useful for specific tasks, a dead end if you are hoping for artificial general intelligence (AGI). She represents a real use case: AI producing consistent content output at a speed no small team could match with human writers alone. Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini are a specific type of generative AI focused on text generation. This includes using AI-generated content without fact-checking, using AI-drafted legal clauses without lawyer review, presenting AI-generated financial projections without underlying verified data, and building customer-facing products that deliver AI output without any human oversight layer. The advantage goes to founders who use AI to free up time for high-quality thinking, customer conversations, and product decisions, not to founders who use AI to avoid those things. The rational position, backed by the actual science from people like Yann LeCun and grounded in real operational experience building products like Fe/male Switch, CADChain, and Learn Dutch with AI, is that AI is a tool with clear strengths and clear limits.
